cues: Each copper ion needs two electrons, so we get half that many moles of copper, times sixty three point five: two point nine six grams on the cathode.
Each oxygen molecule releases four electrons, so a quarter as many moles, times twenty two thousand four hundred: five hundred and twenty two cubic centimetres of oxygen at S T P.
